full_judgment: 5. The suit was contested by the defendant stating, inter alia, that land of CS Plot Nos. 440, 465, 475, 215 and 208 of CS khatian No. 6 of mouza Sarabo belonged to CS record tenants Sarada Prashad Roy Chowdhury and others and that he took settlement of 19.29 acres of land on 12th Poush, 1336 BS and that later on he took settlement of the aforesaid land on 7th Magh, 1336 BS on payment of proper Salami and possession was delivered to him, that he is enjoying the land but because of the laches of the person who was entrusted to get the land recorded in the name of the defendant the land was not recorded during the RS operation in his name, that although at one stage of the RS operation the land was recorded in the name of the defendant and a copy of the TP khatian was given to him but finally, the land was not recorded in the name of the defendant, rather it was recorded in the name of the plaintiff and then the defendant filed Title Suit No. 860 of 1981 seeking right, title and interest in the land in suit, that summons of the suit was duly served on the defendant and the defendant entered appearance, that finally, the suit was decreed ex parte on December 28, 1981, that the Government i.e. the defendant, filed Miscellaneous Case seeking setting aside of the ex parte decree but the same was dismissed on contest on March 28, 1984 and as against that defendant i.e. Government, did not go on appeal. It is the definite case of the defendant that he at no time gave undertaking to the plaintiff that he would not claim the land, that in pursuant to the decree in the Title Suit No. 860 of 1981 the defendant filed Miscellaneous Case No. 46 of 1984 for correction of the record and accordingly, record was corrected in his name.
